captions.detailed: A wide desktop photo-oriented all-in-one printer featuring a light gray body with a flatbed scanner lid on top. The front face includes a small control panel with a black rotary knob and three rectangular function buttons. The scanner lid is designed to swing open via a rear hinge, while sliding paper trays are nested inside the lower main body.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a wide desktop photo-oriented all-in-one printer. Include a main boxy chassis, a flatbed scanner lid hinged at the rear, and a front-facing control panel with a black continuous rotary knob and three small prismatic push buttons.
captions.factory: Construct the main printer body as a large box, hollowed out or subtracted to create the internal paper tray bays. Model the scanner lid as a thin flat box with filleted corners, positioned on a rear revolute joint axis. Create the control panel on the front using a cylinder for the rotary knob and small, offset box primitives for the three prismatic push buttons.
